entry.title: Market brief — 13 November 2026 close (markets closed Saturday 14 November)
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Friday 13 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,144.30 (-155.05, -0.61%) and the Sensex at 81,592.45 (-318.56, -0.39%), with the rupee about 20 paise weaker at 94.24 per dollar. IBJA's final 17:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,35,809 per 10 g (-1,883) and 999 silver at Rs 1,78,000 per kg (-3,040). Markets are closed today, Saturday 14 November 2026; the next session is Monday 16 November 2026.
